name: pushpak-emulator-qa
description: Firestore/Storage rules, role and workflow tests against the Firebase emulators (run via firebase emulators:exec).

scripts.test:rules: mkdir -p results && node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=./gh-reporter.mjs --test-reporter-destination=results/rules.txt --test-reporter=../../scripts/qa/node-json-reporter.mjs --test-reporter-destination=results/rules.json rules.test.mjs roles.test.mjs storage.test.mjs
